questions: this 指一件物品，搭配 is。
orange 的開頭是母音音素，單數前用 an。
Please ___ the red pen on the desk.
祈使句用原形動詞 put。
回答 these 的複數問句用 they are。
This is my pencil. That is ___ pencil.
名詞 pencil 前要用所有格 your。
Do not 後接原形動詞。
One pen and one pen make ___ pens.
第三人稱單數現在式用 drinks。
禮貌提供飲水可用 some water；water 在此不可數。
apples 是可數複數，數量用 how many。
There is ___ rice in the bowl.
rice 為不可數名詞，不能說 a rice。
you 搭配 do 問一般動詞 like。
描述湯的狀態用單數 be 動詞 is。
固定時間搭配 at noon。
There are three ___ on the table.
I am thirsty. May I have ___?
thirsty 表示口渴，需要飲品。
rainy 是形容詞，天氣主詞 it 搭配 is。
What is the weather like 是詢問天氣的句型。
現在正在下雨用 is raining。
The sky is clear, and the sun is bright. It is ___.
晴朗天空與陽光明亮支持 sunny。
autumn 是季節；另外兩個不是季節名稱。
wind 在此為單數／不可數，搭配 is。
天氣問句用 it 回答。
We can make a snowman when it ___.
when 子句需要完整動詞，it 搭配 snows。
can 後接原形動詞 run。
用 can 提問就用 can 回答。
Please ___ your eyes for this game.
祈使句用原形動詞 close。
these 是複數，foot 的複數為 feet。
祈使句以動詞原形開始。
Do you have long hair? No, I ___.
have 一般動詞問句以 do 否定回答。
My brother and I ___ ride bicycles.
can 不因主詞複數而加 s，也不與 are 這樣連用。
The library is ___ the bank and the school.
兩個地點之間用 between ... and ...。
The sign says No running. You should ___.
No running 表示禁止奔跑，應步行。
路口位置使用 at the corner。
The office is on the ___ floor, above the first floor.
The café is ___ from the station, on the other side of the street.
There is a notice ___ the door.
貼在門表面的公告用 on。
The sign Exit points toward the ___.
Do not ___ this gate. It is for staff only.
Do not 後接原形 enter；staff only 是僅限員工。
The room is next ___ the stairs.
Which sentence politely asks for a location?
Where is the school office, please?
Where is ... 詢問位置，please 增加禮貌。
Go straight ___ you reach the bridge.
until 引出持續到達的終點條件。
Walk ___ the bridge to reach the park on the other side.
從橋一端走到另一端用 across。
on your right 表示在右手邊。
___ the second turning on the left.
The station is a ten-minute ___ from here.
a ten-minute walk 是十分鐘的步行距離。
Could you tell me ___ the library is?
where 引導地點的間接問句。
You must cross ___ the traffic light turns green.
when 連接完整子句；另外兩個不能這樣接子句。
The museum is next to the bank, not ___ it.
not inside 區分兩棟相鄰建築，不是博物館位於銀行內部。
After you pass the post office, ___ right.
主要祈使句用原形 turn。
Which reply is useful when you did not hear a direction?
Could you say that again, please?
請求重述直接處理沒聽清楚的情況。
I do not feel well. I ___ tell an adult.
should 後直接接原形動詞 tell；此處練習表達求助。
How ___ water is in the bottle?
water 為不可數，使用 how much。
before eating 表示吃東西之前。
He ___ tired after the long walk.
he 搭配 feels；feel 在此描述狀態。
Which sentence asks for help politely?
Could you help me find the nurse?
Could you help me ... 是合適求助句型。
There are two ___ in the waiting room.
I have a question ___ the school nurse.
a question for someone 表示要向某人問的問題。
We need ___ rest after the activity.
rest 在此為不可數概念，用 some。
The clinic opens ___ eight in the morning.
Some families celebrate together, but customs can ___.
can 後用原形 differ，也提醒習俗並非人人相同。
before taking ... 表示拍照前先詢問。
The visitors ___ sharing stories about their holidays.
Which question avoids assuming everyone has the same custom?
Why does everyone in your country do this?
Your custom must be wrong, right?
詢問個人或家庭做法，避免以國籍概括所有人。
We learned ___ a festival in class.
learn about 表示了解一個主題。
The event is held ___ the community hall.
活動在會館內舉行，用 in。
Each guest ___ a different story to share.
It is important to V 表達尊重的重要性。
A dictionary marks a word with n. What does that label indicate?
The word is used as a noun.
n. 是 noun 的詞性縮寫，不是否定或無意義。
A dictionary entry shows v. Which information does it give?
The word can function as a verb.
The word must begin with v.
v. 標示動詞詞性，不代表字首或音節數。
You do not understand a word in a paragraph. What should you check first?
The sentence context and the relevant dictionary sense.
Only the first translation, regardless of context.
語境有助挑選適合的詞義，不能一律套用第一個譯義。
Which list is in alphabetical order?
先比較共同字母，再比較結束位置與後續字母。
The entry lists two pronunciations for the same spelling. You should ___.
check which meaning and part of speech fit the sentence
assume the spelling has no pronunciation
相同拼字可能依詞性或詞義有不同發音，應配合句子。
Which action gives direct evidence of a word’s pronunciation?
Listening to a reliable dictionary recording.
Guessing solely from the Chinese meaning.
錄音能提供實際發音；字母數與中文意思不能直接判定。
An example sentence in a dictionary mainly helps you ___.
see how a word is used in context
prove that the word has only one meaning
例句展示用法，不表示單字只有一義。
A word is marked adj. Which role is being identified?
adj. 是 adjective，與 adv. 不同。
You hear a word but are unsure of its spelling. A useful next step is to ___.
compare candidate spellings with the sound and sentence meaning
choose a word only because it is the longest
用聲音與語意交叉核對，而非僅看長度。
Why should you check the date or edition of a reference source?
Older sources contain no English words.
The newest source always has the longest definitions.
日期有助判斷資訊是否更新，但不表示舊資料一律無效。
The café is ___ the cinema and the bookstore.
between A and B 表示兩者之間。
Go ___ the tunnel, then cross the square.
Walk ___ the river until you reach the bridge.
The entrance is ___ the corner of Pine Street and Lake Road.
街口位置常用 at the corner of。
Which sentence is an instruction rather than a question?
原形動詞開頭的 Turn left ... 是指示。
The park is directly ___ the school, on the opposite side of the road.
across from 表示隔路相對。
介系詞 after 後可接 crossing。
Do you know ___ bus stops near the museum?
which 修飾 bus，詢問哪一路公車。
The stop is two blocks ___ here.
距離的起點使用 from here。
Which detail would make a route easier to follow?
A landmark at the point where you turn.
轉彎處的地標能提供可操作的定位線索。
In “The committee approved the proposal,” what is the object?
proposal 是 approved 的受詞；committee 是主詞。
Which sentence contains a linking verb followed by a subject complement?
seems 連結主詞與形容詞補語 reasonable。
In “The news made the residents anxious,” anxious functions as ___.
anxious 描述受詞 residents 的狀態。
Which sentence has an indirect object and a direct object?
The organizer sent the participants a reminder.
participants 是間接受詞，reminder 是直接受詞。
In “Several problems remain,” remain is used ___.
此句 remain 沒有直接受詞。
Which change preserves the basic meaning of “She gave me the report”?
She gave the report to me.
She gave me to the report.
She gave to the report me.
give 的直接受詞 report 可配 to me。
Which sentence correctly follows consider + object + complement?
We consider insufficient the evidence is.
We consider the evidence to insufficient.
evidence 後的形容詞 insufficient 是受詞補語。
In “The results became clearer,” clearer describes ___.
became 是連綴動詞，clearer 是主詞補語。
Which sentence requires an object to complete this use of the verb?
discuss 此用法直接接討論內容 findings。
Which sentence contains a complete independent clause?
第一句有主詞 method 與主要動詞 works；其餘不完整。
A report finds that users of a new app studied longer, but they chose the app themselves. Which wording is most justified?
App use was associated with longer study time.
The app certainly caused every user to study longer.
The app removed all differences between learners.
自選使用者的比較只能直接描述關聯，不能確定所有人的因果。
The survey covered one class. Which qualification should a summary retain?
The sample was limited to one class.
Every student had the same preference.
摘要須保留取樣範圍，避免擴張結論。
Which transition fits: “The method is inexpensive. ___, it requires careful training”?
便宜與訓練需求形成轉折。
“Students who returned the form received a reminder.” Who received one?
The students who returned the form.
Every student, whether they returned it or not.
限定關係子句界定收到提醒的學生範圍。
“The result may reflect a seasonal change.” What does may signal?
A possible explanation, not a certainty.
Which sentence correctly introduces a counterpoint?
Although access improved, costs also rose.
Because access improved, costs must never rise.
讓步句承認一項改善，同時提出成本問題。
Which question helps compare two reports on the same topic?
Do they use the same population and time period?
Do their page numbers have the same color?
Are their authors’ first names identical?
對象與期間不同會限制比較。
A chart shows more participants but provides no total enrollment. What is unknown?
Whether the count is a number.
缺少母體總數，無法計算參與率。
Which paraphrase preserves “some participants were dissatisfied”?
A portion of the participants expressed dissatisfaction.
some 不能改寫為 all 或 no。
Which conclusion appropriately acknowledges incomplete evidence?
A wider trial is needed before generalizing.
No additional information could ever matter.
One example proves a universal rule.
證據有限時應擴大檢驗，避免普遍化。
It was the missing comparison group ___ weakened the argument.
It was ... that ... 聚焦名詞片語。
What the researchers need ___ a larger sample.
What 引導的名詞子句在此作整體主詞，補語為 a larger sample，使用 is。
It was not until the data were checked ___ the error became clear.
It was not until ... that ... 為強調時間的結構。
“It was the budget, not the schedule, that changed.” What is emphasized?
The budget was the thing that changed.
The schedule was the only thing that changed.
not the schedule 排除時間表，焦點是預算。
“What matters is how the evidence was collected.” The focus is on ___.
the font used in the report
how 引出蒐集證據的方法。
Which sentence forms a correct cleft?
It was in the final interview that the discrepancy emerged.
It was in the final interview what the discrepancy emerged.
It in the final interview that was emerged.
It was ... that ... 保持主句與焦點結構完整。
“It is the assumptions that require scrutiny.” Which part requires scrutiny?
焦點名詞 assumptions 為需要檢視的對象。
Which sentence correctly focuses on the person?
It was Lin who identified the error.
It Lin was identified who the error.
It was who Lin the error identified.
人物可用 It was ... who ... 聚焦。
“What the team proposed was a small pilot, not a permanent policy.” What was proposed?
small pilot 是有限度試辦，not 排除永久政策。
Why might a writer choose a cleft sentence?
To highlight a specific contrast or piece of information.
To guarantee that a claim is true.
To eliminate the need for evidence.
強調結構調整資訊焦點，不會自動證明內容。
Which question asks for clarification without pretending to understand?
Could you explain what you mean by “baseline”?
I already understand everything, so do not explain.
Your term must be wrong because it is unfamiliar.
具體指出不熟悉的術語，便於講者澄清。
A lecturer says a finding is preliminary. Which note is accurate?
The finding is tentative and needs further examination.
The finding is a final universal law.
The finding has no relation to the topic.
preliminary 表示初步，不能記成最終定論。
Which expression clearly attributes an idea to a source?
According to the study discussed today, ...
It is true because I say so, ...
來源標示讓聽者能追溯資訊。
Which summary preserves “the effect was observed only under laboratory conditions”?
The observed effect was limited to laboratory conditions.
The effect occurs in every real-world setting.
The study ruled out all laboratory effects.
only 的範圍限制不可省略。
When a speaker distinguishes correlation from causation, the key point is that ___.
an association does not by itself establish a cause
兩者概念不同，僅關聯不足以確立因果。
Which presentation sentence separates evidence from interpretation?
The survey recorded fewer visits; one possible explanation is a timetable change.
The survey proves our preferred explanation beyond doubt.
The explanation is a measurement itself.
先報觀察，再清楚標示可能解釋。
Which question is most useful after an unfamiliar technical example?
How does this example illustrate the main claim?
What color is the lecturer’s notebook?
Can we skip the meaning of every term?
把例子連回主旨有助理解論證。
A classmate asks you to slow down. Which response supports communication?
I can restate the point more slowly and check whether it is clear.
You must understand the first explanation.
No one is allowed to ask questions.
重述與確認理解是溝通策略。
Which note is a reasonable paraphrase of “the sample excluded first-year students”?
First-year students were not included in the sample.
Every year group was equally represented.
excluded 表示未納入，不能反轉為 only included。
Which ending invites a focused discussion?
Which assumption in this proposal should we test first?
聚焦可檢驗的假設，能推進討論。
Which goal can be checked after one week?
Summarize three short articles and compare the summaries with the originals.
具體任務與可比對成果比空泛願望可檢核。
You recognize answers while rereading but cannot produce them later. What should change?
Add retrieval without looking at the answer.
Only reread the answer more quickly.
Treat recognition as proof of independent recall.
辨認不等於獨立提取，應增加遮住答案的回想。
Which record is useful for reviewing a writing revision?
The original sentence, feedback, and the reason for the change.
Only the number of times the document was opened.
保留前後與修訂理由，才能檢視改變是否解決問題。
A difficult task was completed with several hints. How should it be recorded?
As assisted practice, with independent performance still to be checked.
As evidence that no further practice is possible.
提示後完成與獨立掌握必須區分。
Return to the skill on several separated days.
Repeat only within one uninterrupted minute and never return.
分散在不同日的回想與練習，能檢查延後提取。
Which source check is most relevant to a factual claim?
Whether the source provides traceable evidence for that claim.
Whether the title uses the largest font.
Whether the author agrees with every personal belief.
查核應關注證據可追溯性，而非外觀或迎合個人偏好。
What is the purpose of keeping an error log?
To identify patterns and plan targeted follow-up practice.
To prove that improvement is impossible.
To replace all future attempts with copied answers.
錯誤紀錄應支援診斷與後續練習。
Which action makes peer feedback more actionable?
Ask the reviewer to point to a specific unclear sentence and explain why.
Remove every sentence the reviewer did not mention.
具體位置與原因有助修訂。
A plan repeatedly exceeds the available study time. What is a sensible adjustment?
Reduce the task size while keeping a measurable goal and review date.
Make the same unrealistic promise again.
可執行的小任務較能支持持續檢核。
Which result best supports a claim of improvement?
Better independent performance on comparable new tasks after a delay.
Only a higher count of clicks.
Only remembering the location of an answer on the screen.
可比較的新任務與延後獨立表現，比點擊或版面記憶更有力。
